title: Corner 1BR Condo w/ Views, Parking + Storage – Noe Valley
body:
1-bedroom corner unit condo located in Noe Valley, within walking distance to the 24th Street corridor, shops, restaurants, and public transportation.

The unit gets good natural light from multiple exposures and has open outlooks with partial water views and surrounding greenery. Interior features include wood flooring, an eat-in kitchen, and a practical layout for everyday living.

The kitchen is equipped with modern appliances, including Miele and Bertazzoni, and offers good counter and cabinet space. The unit also includes in-unit laundry, an individual forced air heating system, and a tankless water heater.

Additional features include:

Garage parking
Deeded storage room
Updated windows for improved insulation and reduced outside noise

The building is a 4-unit property with maintained common areas and outdoor seating space surrounded by landscaping. Originally built in the 1920s, it retains some of its original character while having undergone updates over time.

Conveniently located near neighborhood amenities along 24th Street, with access to transit and nearby services.

Well-suited for anyone looking for a bright corner unit in a central residential neighborhood.

title: $3500 - 1 bed 1 bath flat in beautiful victorian available 8/5
body:
One bedroom with office, living room, dining room, bathroom, and recently remodeled kitchen with dishwasher available in sunny Potrero Hill. The house is located near an open space and a few blocks away from all that the Mission District has to offer, as well as Potrero Hill shops and the Dogpatch. Easy street parking with one residential permit available, washer and dryer on site. This is a three story building with friendly landlords living above you and tenants below on the bottom floor. We like a good neighborly feeling in the building - looking out for each others packages, sharing a cup of sugar, etc. The place is pet friendly, and there are friendly dogs living on site. Due to the building being a 130 year old Victorian, noise transfer between units is unavoidable, but we all try to be very respectful of each other and honor quiet hours, communicate if there is an issue, etc. - but if you're very sensitive to noise this might not be a fit, and folks in the building occasionally work from home. Otherwise, it's a fantastic neighborhood - we throw a block party every December, many people on the block have lived here for decades. Most tenants have stayed for several years or more.

Rent is $3,500 and deposit is $4,000. We will be showing the unit this Saturday and Sunday, June 27-28. Please reach out and tell us about yourself to schedule a time to view the unit. Unit is available 8/5, possibly sooner.
